weather_data.provider: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API, ERA5-Seamless (gridded reanalysis)
weather_data.analog_mapping: Source year = target year minus 2027 plus analog start year. Calendar month/day unchanged.

phenology_reference.source: NASA POWER daily T2M_MAX and T2M_MIN (MERRA-2)
phenology_reference.method: Shared 31-day moving mean of daily maximum and minimum temperature.
